pitch: Probably in B-natural at a = 432; built in B-flat Chorton.
mouthpiece: From a trumpet or alto trombone. German style, ca. 1830; diam. of bowl 18.6, throat 5.2, outlet 8.7, depth of bowl 15.5, total length ca. 70, rim 4.2.
dimensions: bo 9, be 104, le 1230, int. diam. of mouthpipe 11.3.
provenance: Ex coll Paul de Wit.**** [Check Heyde catalog. Kinsky 1913 : 198 gives a sop. by this maker ; no date given, just end 18c. Heyer no. 1880.  ]
remarks: Not playable.6 pos.; one flat bell-stay, tubular slide-stays; Saxon-style rim-wire; no repairs; bell-pipe broken.
